title: For ports whose status is DOWN, list the port ID, tenant ID, port name, MAC
question: For ports whose status is DOWN, list the port ID, tenant ID, port name, MAC address, binding host, and VIF type, along with (1) the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within its security group, (2) the rank of the port among DOWN ports ordered by port ID, and (3) the ratio of the running sum to the rank (rounded to 2 decimals), ordered by this ratio descending.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    p.id AS port_id,
    p.tenant_id,
    p.name AS port_name,
    p.mac_address,
    b.host AS binding_host,
    b.vif_type,
    sg.security_group_id,
    p.standard_attr_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sg ON sg.port_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON b.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT
    port_id,
    tenant_id,
    port_name,
    mac_address,
    binding_host,
    vif_type,
    SUM(standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY security_group_id ORDER BY standard_attr_id) AS running_sum,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY port_id) AS port_rank
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  port_id,
  tenant_id,
  port_name,
  mac_address,
  binding_host,
  vif_type,
  running_sum,
  port_rank,
  ROUND(running_sum / port_rank, 2) AS ratio
FROM windowed
ORDER BY ratio DESC
